gate: Gate-D step 6 (build temporal profile), candidate construction only
supervisor_note: docs/evaluation/supervisor_contract_decision_form.md is unsigned; no supervisor approval is claimed or implied

source_binding.note: opened through the existing open_accepted_dft_snapshot boundary, which re-verifies manifest, receipt, and raw tree before a byte is parsed. A synthetic snapshot is refused outright, and every row must agree with this binding on snapshot id and synthetic flag.

window_measured_not_assumed.interpretation: the real acquisition contains exactly hours 7 through 18, each with the same 3,256 rows. The declared window is confirmed by the data rather than defining it, and the population is perfectly rectangular.

partitions.rule: sha256 of the fixed salt and the count-point id, bucketed over 10,000, held out below 2,000
partitions.share_note: the rule is a hash bucket, so the realised share is near 20% rather than exactly it. The published site counts are the truth; 20% is the target, not a claim about the outcome.
partitions.site_coherence: every hour, direction, and survey date from one site shares that site's partition, so a held-out score cannot be measuring memorisation of a road already seen in development

measured_zeros.why_it_matters: these are hours the survey observed and recorded as zero. They are admitted as zero and flagged measured_zero. Dropping them would bias every mean computed downstream, and filling a missing hour with zero would invent a measurement; the two cases are typed separately and never merge.

recorded_but_never_fused.note: season and day type are attributes of a series, never keys it is aggregated over. Every one of the 3,256 series is one site, one direction, one date. No winter dates appear, consistent with DfT's neutral-day survey design.

boundaries_held.no_utc: the DfT hour is a local clock label under ADR-055 and GA-DFT-1 is open; no instant is produced anywhere in the artifact
boundaries_held.simulation_clock_is_declared: 07:00 local maps to simulation second zero as a modelling convention the operator chose, and the artifact labels it as one rather than presenting it as a discovered instant
boundaries_held.aadf: refused as a profile input with its own reason; AADF is an annual statistical estimate and the Counted/Estimated marker exists only on it, so using raw counts preserves that distinction structurally
boundaries_held.webtris: excluded while GA-WT-1 leaves its clock basis undeclared; mixing an undeclared clock into an hourly profile would produce rows that look comparable and are not
boundaries_held.no_fetch: the profile is built by an operator-invoked CLI over accepted local snapshots, and the read-only service summarises an already-built artifact, so an ordinary UI rerun cannot reach a provider
boundaries_held.raw_inputs_unchanged: the accepted raw tree is read and re-verified, never modified

guards_note: the real Manchester data is complete and rectangular, so no exclusion or coverage refusal fired. Each guard is implemented and adversarially tested; their silence here is a property of this data, not evidence that they are unnecessary.
explicit_non_claims: a temporal profile is not calibration, demand, a baseline, or a simulation input
coverage of 1.000000 measures completeness of the observed window, not accuracy or representativeness
the 80/20 split is a partition of sites, not a validated experimental design
no supervisor approval is claimed; the contract decision form remains unsigned
MAN-09 remains planned and Gate D remains foundation_only
